text: layout follow-ups: view controls beside the list name, a smaller pill, Add inside the list's width, no top New list button

Scope settled with the user after a first version: the controls stay on their own
line under the title, as every list kind keeps its controls row — putting them on
the title line would have had to apply to all kinds, and on Android a shopping
list's controls leave room for only ~7 characters of name in the top bar. Built
and discarded before commit. What remains: the compact pill (no checkmark, less
padding), the web Add button docked to the content column, and the web overview's
New list as the same bottom-right button; plus the Android overview's button in
the primary colours, matching the lists.
